Hafıza kartları (kart eşleştirme) oyunun: Play the memory card matching game free online. Flip the cards and find every pair in as few moves and as little time as possible
Tahtada kapalı kartlar vardır ve her res: The board is full of face-down cards, with two of each picture. Click or tap a card to flip it, then flip a second card to look for its pair. Matching cards stay face up; if they differ, they flip back after a moment. Flipping two cards counts as one move. The game ends when you find every pair. The goal is to finish in as few moves and as little time as possible
<strong>Klasik 4x4</strong> modunda 16 k: Classic 4x4 mode is a single 16-card board, and your fewest moves are saved as your "Best" record. The daily challenge always uses this mode, so everyone playing that day gets the same board.
<strong>Sefer</strong> modu 12 bölümlük: Journey mode is a 12-level campaign. The board grows level by level: it starts at 4x4, goes through 5x4, 6x4 and 6x5, and ends with a 36-card 6x6 board. Finishing a level earns 1 star; finish in fewer moves for 2 or 3 stars. Each box on the map shows the board size and the stars you've collected. A level unlocks once you earn at least 1 star on the previous one. The last two levels are timed: if time runs out you lose and try again. Stars you've earned are never taken away, and you can replay a level to earn more.
Topladığınız yıldızlar yeni kart destele: Your stars unlock new card decks: Fruit at 10 stars, Space at 20 and Animals at 30. Pick an unlocked theme from the strip below the board; it's also used in Classic mode. Your progress is saved automatically on this device
Açılan kartların yerlerini satır satır e: Try to memorize revealed cards row by row. Exploring the board in your first moves helps you find pairs quickly later. On big boards, start flipping from the corners and remember positions with short labels like "top row, second from right". In timed levels, don't rush into random flips; after revealing an unknown card, look for its pair where you remember seeing it
<strong>Sefer modu rekorumu etkiler mi?<: Does Journey mode affect my record? No. The "Best" move record is only set in Classic 4x4; each Journey level has its own leaderboard.
<strong>Kilitli bölümü nasıl açarım?</st: How do I unlock a locked level? Just finish the level before it; even one star unlocks the next.
